title: Temporal encryption evidence bundler and export protocol
creator: Alicia Mendez
description: Build a compact, time-bounded artifact format and automated pipeline that bundles key-rotation events, KMS/HSM signatures, and residency metadata into verifiable evidence packages suitable for regulatory export and internal audits. The goal is to produce reproducible artifacts that: 1) can be checked by auditors without access to internal systems, 2) remain small enough for efficient storage and transfer across regions, and 3) preserve cryptographic provenance (signatures, merkle roots, event timestamps).
acceptance_criteria: Generate evidence bundles for scheduled and ad-hoc key rotations that include rotation metadata, key IDs, wrapped key references, nonces, and HSM signatures
Bundles are timestamped and include a Merkle root over contained events; the bundler publishes a compact index for fast verification
Automated export pipeline uploads bundles to customer-residency-aware storage endpoints (regional S3 buckets) and registers metadata in BigQuery for reporting
End-to-end test harness verifies signature validity using a verification key that does not require HSM access
Bundle size targets: median bundle < 1.2 MB for a daily tenant, 99th percentile < 8 MB; export latency < 10 minutes after rotation processing for non-archival flows
Failure modes documented; on HSM signing failure, an attestation placeholder is emitted and retried, and a high-severity alert is raised in PagerDuty
implementation_steps: Design artifact schema (CBOR + compressed JSON manifest) and Merkle layout; document fields and versioning
Prototype a bundler lambda that ingests rotation events from rotation-event topic and produces signed bundles
Integrate HSM signing flow: use KEK-wrapped signer key and recorded signature envelope; implement retry/backoff and offline signing grace window
Build export controller that routes bundles to region-aware S3 + copies a compact index row to BigQuery with tenant, bundle-id, region, time-range
Add verification tooling: small CLI and cloud function to validate signatures and Merkle proofs without HSM (verification key fetched from KMS public endpoint)
Create e2e tests including chaos scenarios (HSM latency, KMS rate-limits, cross-region network partitions)
Add Console dashboard card and an export endpoint for compliance support teams to download bundles per-tenant
notes: Trade-offs considered: store full unredacted rotation payloads vs redacted summaries. Chosen approach: full payloads encrypted with customer KEK; index contains redacted fields for searchability.
Compression: use zstd level 3 for reasonable CPU/size tradeoff; evaluate moving to delta encoding for tenants with high churn.
Ledger anchoring: plan to anchor daily bundle Merkle roots into internal audit-merkle service (future work), for now publish signed root in BigQuery and Console.
Operational concern: HSM signing concurrency. Implement token bucket and retry queue; coordinated with Crypto O&M for quota bump during rollout.
Data residency: export controller must respect tenant.region and write only to allowed destinations; integration tests will validate cross-region restrictions.
